fields.description: Hillsedge offers one and two bedroom apartments beside Hillside Park in Dubai Hills Estate. The scheme combines two residential towers with lower-level Park Apartments. Its appeal centres on outdoor activity, with building pools and a gym complemented by the neighbouring park’s recreation spaces.
amenities: Park sports courts and jogging tracks

overview: Open kitchens, neutral interior finishes and balconies define the apartment layouts. Hillside Park broadens the outdoor offering with sports, play and social spaces. The brochure explicitly locates facilities across the podium and adjacent park, so the cinema, amphitheatre, skate facilities and jogging areas should not be read as private amenities inside every tower.
research.locationNote: Hillsedge is positioned by Hillside Park near King’s College Hospital, with Dubai Hills Mall and Golf Club in the wider district. Al Khail Road connects the community to the city. Check the actual pedestrian route and selected unit’s view. Future Metro or rail references are not evidence of an operating station at the development.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s unit panel starts at AED 1,844,888 on the review date. Its headline rounds this to AED 1.84m; the launch fact sheet lists one-bedroom starts of AED 1.84m and two-bedroom starts of AED 2.69m. Request a current quotation for the chosen unit.
research.paymentNote: Both launch schedules allocate 80% before completion and 20% at completion. Tower B’s first four payments fall one month later than Tower A’s. The combined table identifies the tower-specific dates; it is not an additional set of instalments.
research.handoverNote: Both tower payment plans estimate January 2029 completion, corroborated by Property Finder. Confirm the current construction position and applicable contractual date before relying on this target.

facts.label: Published development mix
facts.value: The launch fact sheet lists 204 one-bedroom and 202 two-bedroom homes, totalling 406 apartments. This is the development mix, not remaining availability.

facts.label: Park Apartment layout
facts.value: Two-bedroom Park type B has two balconies, two bathrooms, a walk-in wardrobe and laundry. Its 1,092.43 sq ft total includes 70.61 sq ft of balconies. The plan locates these homes on ground and podium levels.

facts.label: A larger one-bedroom variant
facts.value: Tower B unit 109, type A.3, totals 840.23 sq ft, including a 168.02 sq ft balcony. This exceeds the launch fact sheet’s rounded 779 sq ft maximum; the detailed plan is used here.

facts.label: Later purchase terms may differ
facts.value: Property Finder also lists a 30/50/20 option alongside 10/70/20. The schedules above reproduce the dated tower launch documents, not a promise of the deposit required for a purchase today.
